admit site vm of f2a9c4e1-0b7d-4c3a-9e2f-5a6b7c8d9e01 as paisans-f2a9 on fake (ubuntu 24.04)

step 1: start paisans-f2a9's manager after the mesh
  user: order user@1001.service after wg-quick@psns-f2a9 at boot, so a container that publishes on the mesh address finds it; a manager running now is not restarted, and takes it at its next start
  write /etc/systemd/system/user@1001.service.d/paisans-mesh.conf mode 0644:
    | # Written by paisans host admit for deployment f2a9; paisans host evict
    | # removes it. The user's manager, its Docker daemon and its containers
    | # start after the mesh at boot.
    | [Unit]
    | Wants=wg-quick@psns-f2a9.service
    | After=wg-quick@psns-f2a9.service
  run:
    $ systemctl daemon-reload

step 2: delegate cgroups to users
  delegation: let every user's manager delegate cpu cpuset io memory pids, for compose's limits; paisans-f2a9's manager is running, and takes it at its next start
  write /etc/systemd/system/user@.service.d/delegate.conf mode 0644:
    | # Written by paisans host admit. Shared by every admitted deployment;
    | # paisans host evict removes it with the last of them.
    | [Service]
    | Delegate=cpu cpuset io memory pids
  run:
    $ systemctl daemon-reload

step 3: load br_netfilter
  daemon: load br_netfilter now, which the user's daemon needs with its userland proxy off
  run:
    $ modprobe br_netfilter

step 4: load br_netfilter at boot
  daemon: list br_netfilter and nf_tables in /etc/modules-load.d/paisans.conf, shared by every admitted deployment
  write /etc/modules-load.d/paisans.conf mode 0644:
    | # Written by paisans host admit. The rootless Docker daemons of admitted
    | # deployments need br_netfilter to start with their userland proxy off,
    | # and the module their iptables uses for the setup tool to install them.
    | br_netfilter
    | nf_tables

step 5: write paisans-f2a9's daemon.json
  daemon: userland proxy off, address pools clear of the mesh; written as paisans-f2a9
  run:
    $ runuser -u paisans-f2a9 -- env -i HOME='/home/paisans-f2a9' PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1001 DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1001/bus DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/1001/docker.sock sh -c 'umask 077 && mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/docker" && cat > "$HOME/.config/docker/.daemon.json.paisans-tmp" && mv -f "$HOME/.config/docker/.daemon.json.paisans-tmp" "$HOME/.config/docker/daemon.json"'
  stdin:
    | {
    |   "userland-proxy": false,
    |   "default-address-pools": [
    |     {
    |       "base": "172.17.0.0/16",
    |       "size": 24
    |     },
    |     {
    |       "base": "172.18.0.0/16",
    |       "size": 24
    |     },
    |     {
    |       "base": "172.19.0.0/16",
    |       "size": 24
    |     },
    |     {
    |       "base": "172.20.0.0/14",
    |       "size": 24
    |     },
    |     {
    |       "base": "172.24.0.0/14",
    |       "size": 24
    |     },
    |     {
    |       "base": "172.28.0.0/14",
    |       "size": 24
    |     },
    |     {
    |       "base": "192.168.0.0/16",
    |       "size": 24
    |     }
    |   ]
    | }

step 6: install paisans-f2a9's rootless Docker
  daemon: dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh install --force, as paisans-f2a9, which starts the daemon reading its daemon.json; --force because a system daemon may run beside it
  run:
    $ runuser -u paisans-f2a9 -- env -i HOME='/home/paisans-f2a9' PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1001 DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1001/bus DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/1001/docker.sock sh -c 'dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh install --force'

step 7: create /srv/paisans
  directory: every deployment's directory lives in it, root's, mode 755
  run:
    $ install -d -m 755 -o root -g root /srv/paisans

step 8: create /srv/paisans/f2a9
  directory: the deployment's own, paisans-f2a9's, mode 750
  run:
    $ install -d -m 750 -o paisans-f2a9 -g paisans-f2a9 /srv/paisans/f2a9

step 9: create /usr/local/libexec/paisans
  wireguard: where each deployment's helper lives, root's, mode 755
  run:
    $ install -d -m 755 -o root -g root /usr/local/libexec/paisans

step 10: install the WireGuard helper
  wireguard: the one command paisans-f2a9 may run as root: it checks each conf before wg-quick sees it, and adds the mesh's mark
  write /usr/local/libexec/paisans/wg-psns-f2a9 mode 0755:
    | #!/bin/sh
    | # The WireGuard helper for psns-f2a9, rendered by paisans with this
    | # deployment's interface, listen port and mesh subnet built in. paisans host
    | # admit installs it as /usr/local/libexec/paisans/wg-psns-f2a9, root's and mode 755, with one sudoers line
    | # that lets the deployment's user run it, and nothing else, as root.
    | #
    | # Creating psns-f2a9, installing its conf and syncing its peers need
    | # CAP_NET_ADMIN in the host's network namespace, which the deployment's user
    | # does not have. wg-quick runs a conf's PreUp, PostUp, PreDown and PostDown as
    | # root, so a helper that installed any conf it was given would hand root to
    | # its caller. put therefore installs only a conf made of the keys paisans
    | # renders, each value matching its pattern, the ListenPort the owner admitted
    | # and addresses inside the mesh subnet; anything else refuses the whole file
    | # and installs nothing.
    | #
    | # The verbs are the only arguments it takes:
    | #   put           read a conf on stdin, check it, install it as /etc/wireguard/psns-f2a9.conf, 600,
    | #                 with this deployment's FwMark added, in a directory only
    | #                 root may write
    | #   up            systemctl enable --now wg-quick@psns-f2a9
    | #   restart       systemctl restart wg-quick@psns-f2a9
    | #   sync          wg-quick strip the installed conf, then wg syncconf
    | #   show FIELD    wg show psns-f2a9 FIELD: peers, latest-handshakes,
    | #                 public-key, allowed-ips, persistent-keepalive or listen-port,
    | #                 each of which the conf holds already or says how the mesh is
    | #                 doing; no key the interface keeps secret, and no address a
    | #                 peer last sent from
    | #   log           the unit's last 200 journal lines
    | # A wrong verb or argument count exits 64; a refused conf exits 65.
    | set -eu
    | PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
    | LC_ALL=C
    | export PATH LC_ALL
    | umask 077
    | 
    | iface='psns-f2a9'
    | dir='/etc/wireguard'
    | conf="$dir/$iface.conf"
    | unit='wg-quick@psns-f2a9'
    | # The admitted ListenPort, 0 for a site nothing dials, whose conf has none.
    | port='51820'
    | # The mesh subnet, as its network address and prefix length.
    | net='10.44.0.0'
    | prefix='24'
    | # The uid that must own the conf directory: root on a host.
    | owner='0'
    | # The mark put adds to every conf it installs: the egress table drops what
    | # a socket with it sends to this host, loopback, link-local, multicast and
    | # the private ranges, after wg has resolved each Endpoint as root.
    | fwmark='0x5053f2a9'
    | # The largest conf put reads. A mesh of a hundred sites is under 20 KiB.
    | max=65536
    | 
    | usage() {
    | 	echo "usage: $0 put | up | restart | sync | show peers|latest-handshakes|public-key|allowed-ips|persistent-keepalive|listen-port | log" >&2
    | 	exit 64
    | }
    | 
    | refuse() {
    | 	echo "wg-$iface: $1; nothing was installed" >&2
    | 	exit 65
    | }
    | 
    | # check reads a conf on stdin and prints why it is refused, exiting 1, or
    | # prints nothing and exits 0. Keys and section names are matched exactly, as
    | # the renderer writes them; a hook key is refused in any section, in any case
    | # and with any whitespace around it. It is POSIX awk only, with no regular
    | # expression intervals, for mawk, gawk, BSD awk and busybox awk alike, so no ^ operator.
    | check() {
    | 	awk -v port="$port" -v net="$net" -v prefix="$prefix" '
    | 	function why(msg) { if (!failed) reason = msg; failed = 1 }
    | 	function no(msg) { why("line " NR ": " msg); exit 1 }
    | 	function ip4(s,    a, n, i, v) {
    | 		n = split(s, a, ".")
    | 		if (n != 4) return -1
    | 		v = 0
    | 		for (i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
    | 			if (a[i] !~ /^(0|[1-9][0-9]?[0-9]?)$/ || a[i] + 0 > 255) return -1
    | 			v = v * 256 + a[i]
    | 		}
    | 		return v
    | 	}
    | 	# blockedval is whether the address value v is in 0.0.0.0/8, 127.0.0.0/8,
    | 	# 169.254.0.0/16 or 224.0.0.0/3.
    | 	function blockedval(v) { return v < 16777216 || int(v / 16777216) == 127 || int(v / 65536) == 43518 || v >= 3758096384 }
    | 	function hexval(s,    i, v) {
    | 		v = 0
    | 		for (i = 1; i <= length(s); i++) v = v * 16 + index("0123456789abcdef", substr(s, i, 1)) - 1
    | 		return v
    | 	}
    | 	# blocked is whether an Endpoint host is a literal loopback, unspecified,
    | 	# link-local or multicast address, in any spelling libc or the kernel
    | 	# reads as one: 127.1, 2130706433, 0177.0.0.1, 0x7f.0.0.1, [::1], [ff02::1]
    | 	# (all of ff00::/8), and localhost. It does not block names, which wg resolves as root at every
    | 	# up, restart and sync; the non-loopback addresses of this host; or LAN
    | 	# addresses, which stay allowed because two sites may share a LAN. Kernel
    | 	# WireGuard sends from no UID, so the UID-matched egress table does not
    | 	# see its packets, and after a handshake its transport packets carry
    | 	# content the deployment user can choose. The guard for this traffic
    | 	# belongs to the egress table (spec, Egress), not to this helper; this
    | 	# check only keeps the handshake off this host and its link.
    | 	function blocked(h,    l, r, a, n, i) {
    | 		if (substr(h, 1, 1) == "[") {
    | 			h = tolower(substr(h, 2, length(h) - 2))
    | 			if (h ~ /^[0:]+$/ || h ~ /^[0:]*:0*1$/ || h ~ /^fe[89ab][0-9a-f]:/ || h ~ /^ff/) return 1
    | 			r = h
    | 			if (sub(/^[0:]*:(ffff:)?/, "", r)) {
    | 				if (r ~ /^[0-9.]+$/) return ip4(r) < 0 || blockedval(ip4(r))
    | 				if (r ~ /^[0-9a-f]+:[0-9a-f]+$/) {
    | 					split(r, a, ":")
    | 					return blockedval(hexval(a[1]) * 65536 + hexval(a[2]))
    | 				}
    | 			}
    | 			return 0
    | 		}
    | 		if (h ~ /^[0-9.]+$/) {
    | 			n = ip4(h)
    | 			return n < 0 || blockedval(n)
    | 		}
    | 		n = split(h, a, ".")
    | 		for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (a[i] ~ /^0[xX][0-9A-Fa-f]*$/) return 1
    | 		l = tolower(h)
    | 		sub(/\.$/, "", l)
    | 		return l == "localhost" || l ~ /\.localhost$/
    | 	}
    | 	# cidr parses address/prefix into cv and cp, false when it is not one.
    | 	function cidr(s,    a) {
    | 		if (split(s, a, "/") != 2 || a[2] !~ /^(0|[1-9][0-9]?)$/ || a[2] + 0 > 32) return 0
    | 		cp = a[2] + 0
    | 		cv = ip4(a[1])
    | 		return cv >= 0
    | 	}
    | 	# inside is whether the parsed cv/cp lies inside the mesh subnet.
    | 	function inside(    d) {
    | 		if (cp < prefix) return 0
    | 		d = pow2(32 - prefix)
    | 		return int(cv / d) == int(netv / d)
    | 	}
    | 	# pow2 is 2 to the n, by multiplying: busybox awk built without math
    | 	# support rejects the ^ operator.
    | 	function pow2(n,    r) {
    | 		for (r = 1; n > 0; n--) r *= 2
    | 		return r
    | 	}
    | 	function key(s) { return length(s) == 44 && s ~ /^[A-Za-z0-9+\/]+=$/ }
    | 	function num(s, lo, hi) { return s ~ /^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/ && length(s) <= 5 && s + 0 >= lo && s + 0 <= hi }
    | 	BEGIN {
    | 		netv = ip4(net)
    | 		if (netv < 0 || !num(prefix, 1, 32) || !num(port, 0, 65535)) { why("the helper was rendered with a bad subnet or port"); exit 1 }
    | 	}
    | 	/\r/ { no("a carriage return; write the conf with Unix line endings") }
    | 	/^[ \t]*$/ { next }
    | 	/^[ \t]*#/ { next }
    | 	{
    | 		line = $0
    | 		sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", line)
    | 		sub(/[ \t]+$/, "", line)
    | 		if (substr(line, 1, 1) == "[") {
    | 			if (line == "[Interface]") {
    | 				if (interfaces || peers) no("a second [Interface], or one after a [Peer]")
    | 				interfaces = 1; section = "Interface"
    | 			} else if (line == "[Peer]") {
    | 				if (!interfaces) no("[Peer] before [Interface]")
    | 				if (section == "Peer" && !pub) no("the [Peer] before this one has no PublicKey")
    | 				peers++; pub = 0; section = "Peer"
    | 			} else {
    | 				no("section " line " is not [Interface] or [Peer]")
    | 			}
    | 			next
    | 		}
    | 		eq = index(line, "=")
    | 		if (eq == 0) no("\"" line "\" is not key = value")
    | 		k = substr(line, 1, eq - 1)
    | 		v = substr(line, eq + 1)
    | 		sub(/[ \t]+$/, "", k)
    | 		sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", v)
    | 		lk = tolower(k)
    | 		if (lk == "preup" || lk == "postup" || lk == "predown" || lk == "postdown") no(k " runs a command as root, and no conf may carry one")
    | 		if (lk == "fwmark") no(k " is set by this helper, never by the conf")
    | 		if (section == "") no(k " before any section")
    | 		if (seen[peers, k]++) no("a second " k " in one section")
    | 		if (section == "Interface") {
    | 			if (k == "Address") {
    | 				if (!cidr(v) || cp != prefix || !inside()) no("Address " v " is not one address in " net "/" prefix)
    | 				# The network names the subnet and the broadcast reaches every
    | 				# host on it, so no site holds either, as validate says.
    | 				if (cv == netv || cv == netv + pow2(32 - prefix) - 1) no("Address " v " is the network or broadcast address of " net "/" prefix)
    | 				address = 1
    | 			} else if (k == "PrivateKey") {
    | 				if (!key(v)) no("PrivateKey is not a WireGuard key")
    | 				private = 1
    | 			} else if (k == "ListenPort") {
    | 				if (port == 0) no("ListenPort " v ", but this deployment was admitted with none on this host")
    | 				if (v != port) no("ListenPort " v ", but this deployment was admitted on " port)
    | 				listen = 1
    | 			} else if (k == "MTU") {
    | 				if (!num(v, 1280, 9000)) no("MTU " v " is not from 1280 to 9000")
    | 			} else {
    | 				no(k " is not a key paisans writes in [Interface]")
    | 			}
    | 		} else {
    | 			if (k == "PublicKey") {
    | 				if (!key(v)) no("PublicKey is not a WireGuard key")
    | 				pub = 1
    | 			} else if (k == "PresharedKey") {
    | 				if (!key(v)) no("PresharedKey is not a WireGuard key")
    | 			} else if (k == "AllowedIPs") {
    | 				if (v == "") no("AllowedIPs is empty")
    | 				n = split(v, ips, ",")
    | 				for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
    | 					s = ips[i]
    | 					sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", s)
    | 					sub(/[ \t]+$/, "", s)
    | 					if (!cidr(s) || !inside()) no("AllowedIPs " s " is not inside " net "/" prefix)
    | 				}
    | 			} else if (k == "Endpoint") {
    | 				p = v
    | 				sub(/^.*:/, "", p)
    | 				if (v !~ /^([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9.-]*|\[[0-9A-Fa-f:.]+\]):[0-9]+$/ || !num(p, 1, 65535)) no("Endpoint " v " is not host:port")
    | 				h = v
    | 				sub(/:[0-9]+$/, "", h)
    | 				if (blocked(h)) no("Endpoint " v " is a loopback, link-local, multicast or unspecified address")
    | 			} else if (k == "PersistentKeepalive") {
    | 				if (!num(v, 0, 65535)) no("PersistentKeepalive " v " is not from 0 to 65535")
    | 			} else {
    | 				no(k " is not a key paisans writes in [Peer]")
    | 			}
    | 		}
    | 	}
    | 	END {
    | 		if (!failed) {
    | 			if (!interfaces) why("no [Interface]")
    | 			else if (!address) why("no Address")
    | 			else if (!private) why("no PrivateKey")
    | 			else if (port != 0 && !listen) why("no ListenPort, but this deployment was admitted on " port)
    | 			else if (section == "Peer" && !pub) why("the last [Peer] has no PublicKey")
    | 		}
    | 		if (failed) { print reason; exit 1 }
    | 	}'
    | }
    | 
    | # rootonly is whether $dir is owned by $owner and neither its group nor
    | # others may write it, read from ls -ldn, which POSIX defines and every
    | # ls prints alike: the mode, the link count, then the numeric owner. A
    | # listing that cannot be read or parsed, or that marks an ACL with +, is
    | # not root's alone.
    | rootonly() {
    | 	listing=$(ls -ldn "$dir") || return 1
    | 	set -f
    | 	# shellcheck disable=SC2086
    | 	set -- $listing
    | 	set +f
    | 	[ $# -ge 3 ] || return 1
    | 	case "$1" in
    | 	??????????+*) return 1 ;;
    | 	d????-??-*) ;;
    | 	*) return 1 ;;
    | 	esac
    | 	[ "$3" = "$owner" ]
    | }
    | 
    | put() {
    | 	if [ ! -d "$dir" ] || [ -L "$dir" ]; then
    | 		refuse "$dir is not a directory"
    | 	fi
    | 	# A directory the deployment's user could write would let it plant a
    | 	# conf with PostUp, which wg-quick runs as root at the next up, past
    | 	# every check below. host admit makes it root's, 700; put checks it
    | 	# each time rather than trusting that it stayed so.
    | 	if ! rootonly; then
    | 		refuse "$dir is not a directory only root may write"
    | 	fi
    | 	# -d follows a link, so a link to a directory is refused here too. A link
    | 	# to anything else is replaced by the rename below, never written through.
    | 	if [ -d "$conf" ]; then
    | 		refuse "$conf is a directory"
    | 	fi
    | 	tmp=$(mktemp "$dir/.$iface.conf.XXXXXX")
    | 	trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
    | 	head -c $((max + 1)) > "$tmp"
    | 	size=$(($(wc -c < "$tmp")))
    | 	if [ "$size" -gt "$max" ]; then
    | 		refuse "the conf is larger than $max bytes"
    | 	fi
    | 	if [ "$(($(tr -d '\000' < "$tmp" | wc -c)))" -ne "$size" ]; then
    | 		refuse "the conf has a NUL byte"
    | 	fi
    | 	if ! reason=$(check < "$tmp"); then
    | 		refuse "$reason"
    | 	fi
    | 	marked=$(mktemp "$dir/.$iface.conf.XXXXXX")
    | 	trap 'rm -f "$tmp" "$marked"' EXIT
    | 	# The mark on the line after [Interface], which check has seen exactly
    | 	# once, before any [Peer].
    | 	awk -v mark="$fwmark" '{ print } !done && /^[ \t]*\[Interface\][ \t]*$/ { print "FwMark = " mark; done = 1 }' "$tmp" > "$marked"
    | 	chmod 600 "$marked"
    | 	mv -f "$marked" "$conf"
    | 	rm -f "$tmp"
    | 	trap - EXIT
    | }
    | 
    | case "${1-}" in
    | put)
    | 	[ $# -eq 1 ] || usage
    | 	put
    | 	;;
    | up)
    | 	[ $# -eq 1 ] || usage
    | 	exec systemctl enable --now "$unit"
    | 	;;
    | restart)
    | 	[ $# -eq 1 ] || usage
    | 	exec systemctl restart "$unit"
    | 	;;
    | sync)
    | 	[ $# -eq 1 ] || usage
    | 	# Through a file rather than a pipe: sh has no pipefail, so a strip that
    | 	# failed would hand syncconf an empty conf, and syncconf removes every
    | 	# peer it is not given.
    | 	# In the conf directory, beside the conf, never under a TMPDIR: it holds
    | 	# the private key.
    | 	stripped=$(mktemp "$dir/.$iface.strip.XXXXXX")
    | 	trap 'rm -f "$stripped"' EXIT
    | 	wg-quick strip "$conf" > "$stripped"
    | 	wg syncconf "$iface" "$stripped"
    | 	;;
    | show)
    | 	[ $# -eq 2 ] || usage
    | 	case "$2" in
    | 	peers | latest-handshakes | public-key | allowed-ips | persistent-keepalive | listen-port) exec wg show "$iface" "$2" ;;
    | 	*) usage ;;
    | 	esac
    | 	;;
    | log)
    | 	[ $# -eq 1 ] || usage
    | 	exec journalctl -u "$unit" -n 200 --no-pager
    | 	;;
    | *)
    | 	usage
    | 	;;
    | esac

step 11: install the helper's sudoers line
  wireguard: /etc/sudoers.d/paisans-f2a9, mode 440, checked by visudo under a name sudo skips before it is moved into place
  write /etc/sudoers.d/paisans-f2a9.new mode 0440:
    | paisans-f2a9 ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/local/libexec/paisans/wg-psns-f2a9
  run:
    $ visudo -cqf /etc/sudoers.d/paisans-f2a9.new && chown root:root /etc/sudoers.d/paisans-f2a9.new && mv -f /etc/sudoers.d/paisans-f2a9.new /etc/sudoers.d/paisans-f2a9 || { rm -f /etc/sudoers.d/paisans-f2a9.new; echo 'visudo refused the line; nothing reached sudo'; exit 1; }

present: docker: Engine 29.9.1
present: package: docker-ce-rootless-extras installed
present: package: uidmap installed
present: package: nftables installed
present: package: wireguard-tools installed
present: package: ufw installed
present: package: git installed
present: apparmor: rootlesskit's profile is loaded
present: user: paisans-f2a9 exists, uid 1001, in no privileged group, and sudo grants it nothing beyond admit's helper
present: user: paisans-f2a9 holds 165536-231071 in /etc/subuid
present: user: paisans-f2a9 holds 165536-231071 in /etc/subgid
